seo.title: Book an appointment with the designer | Awrea Paris
seo.description: A video call with the designer, for a question about size or a first made-to-measure appointment: choose your day and your time.

chapeau: Before ordering a piece, talk it over with the designer by video call, from home: a question about size, a first made-to-measure project. Choose the day and the time, and they are kept for you.

visio.texte: To talk about a piece, a size or a project, from your phone or your computer.

sur-mesure.texte: Your wishes, the materials and the first ideas for your piece. The designer guides you in taking your measurements.

aucunJour: No free days in the coming weeks. Write to us and we will find a time.

champs.message: What you would like to talk about (optional)
champs.accord: I agree that my details are used for this appointment, and for nothing else.

confirme.texte: {rendezvous}, {quand}. A confirmation email is on its way to {email}, with the invitation for your calendar.

erreur: The booking did not go through. Choose another time, or write to us.

seo.title: Cancel an appointment | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Cancel an appointment with the Awrea Paris designer.

annulation.texte: {rendezvous}, {quand}. If you cancel, the time goes to another client.

fait.texte: The appointment has been released. You can book another whenever you wish.

invalide.titre: This link is no longer valid
invalide.texte: The appointment may already have been cancelled. Write to us at {email} if needed.

annulation.erreur: The cancellation did not go through. Try again in a moment, or write to us.
